segments.oily: Reviewers with oily/oily-combination skin report the serum absorbs quickly without adding shine and does not increase oiliness, even around the nose.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the serum as hydrating and non-drying, saying it leaves skin plump and smooth without flaking or tightness, though one dry-skin reviewer needed a rich moisturizer on top.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin generally report no irritation and note brightening and smoother texture, though one combination-skin reviewer found it too heavy and thick and had an adverse reaction.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers who identify as sensitive report the serum is gentle and non-irritating, though one sensitive reviewer had a fragrance reaction and another notes it can tingle on application.
segments.normal: A reviewer with normal skin living in a dry climate reports fast fading of hyperpigmentation with no added dryness.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers report fading dark spots, brightening and smoother texture, though one mature-skin reviewer had to stop use due to a fragrance reaction.

concerns.aging: Reviewers targeting fine lines and wrinkles report softening of fine lines and a more youthful, plumped look; one reviewer specifically credits it with reduced forehead lines within two weeks.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers describe the serum as hydrating, leaving skin feeling plump and soft rather than dry; one dry-skin user needed to layer a rich moisturizer afterward.
concerns.redness: Reviewers largely report no redness or irritation, including those with reactive or sensitive skin; no reviewer describes new redness.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers with reactive or resurfacing-sensitive skin note no compromise to comfort, describing no tightness, flaking, or dryness even with regular use; one combination-skin reviewer describes irritation and heaviness instead.
concerns.spots: The great majority of reviewers targeting dark spots, sun spots, melasma or post-acne marks report visible fading within one to six weeks; one reviewer reports the opposite, developing new age spots and dark circles after use.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers report no new breakouts and some note post-acne marks fading, though one combination-skin reviewer reports irritation from the product and one sensitive-skin reviewer notes a tingling sensation on application.
concerns.oiliness: Oily and combination-oily reviewers report the serum does not make skin greasier and absorbs cleanly, though one reviewer notes she must avoid layering other hydrating serums with it to prevent oiliness.

extraits.texte: The product has strong results but sadly, I had to stop using it due to a reaction to the fragrance. I encourage you to please develop a robust fragrance-free line. Your products are so beneficial, especially for mature skin, but some are difficult to use for those with fragrance sensitivities.

extraits.titre: Didn't work for my skin, but might work for others
extraits.texte: Really wanted to like this serum, but unfortunately it didn't work well for my skin. I have combination skin, and this was the only new product I added to my routine , so I'm pretty sure it was the cause of the irritation I felt. It just felt a bit too heavy and thick on my face, and I noticed my skin didn't react well to it. I've had similar issues with other Vitamin C serums in the past, so this could just be my skin being picky. If your skin typically does well with Vitamin C, it might be worth trying, just wasn't the right fit for me. :/ Complimentary from elemis

Gifted by Elemis. This antioxidant vitamin C serum helps brighten skin and make skin tone more even. I have dry skin, and this feels hydrating yet light, so I follow it with a rich moisturizer. The texture is on the thicker side, almost like a cream. I haven't noticed any significant improvement in my discoloration yet, but I appreciate that the serum does not irritate my skin. it does contain added fragrance, which is not my preference, but it's a pleasant, almost peachy scent.

I've been using the Elemis Dynamic Resurfacing Super-C Serum every morning for the last 14 days, and as a 35-year-old with combination skin that leans dry, I've been really happy with how it's been performing. My main focus is on fine lines, dullness, and keeping my skin looking bouncy and bright, especially around my forehead and smile lines. This serum is doing exactly what I was hoping it would, but in a way that feels gentle and consistent rather than harsh or overly active. The texture is silky and smooth, not too thick, and it spreads easily across the skin. It sinks in quickly without feeling sticky or heavy, which I really appreciate in a morning product. I haven't experienced any pilling under SPF or makeup. There's a light citrusy scent that smells clean and fresh but doesn't hang around long, and it hasn't caused any irritation or sensitivity for me. After two weeks, my skin looks noticeably brighter and more even. I've also started to see a softening in some of the fine lines on my forehead, and the dullness I usually notice first thing in the morning has eased up. Everything just looks a bit more alive and smooth. I haven't had any dry patches or tightness while using this, which is a win considering some resurfacing products can really dry me out. This serum feels like a great fit for my routine right now. It gives me that gentle resurfacing and brightening I want without any discomfort, and it's helped give my skin a healthier, more refreshed look. Note: Produc

Wow. Using this (along with the Elemis resurfacing cleanser) I feel like I have been seeing seriously results. My skin looks way more even and has a certain clarity about it. Like when I go to conceal my dark marks I have to look harder for r hem because they are less noticeable. I use this morning and night. I love the gel type texture that absorbs right in and leaves the skin feeling hydrated. I have mature and oily skin and this has caused no irritation or breakouts. I like to use this on slightly damp skin…it seems to glide on even better that way. I just feel like I have a renewed luminosity with this. I kinda hate how much I love this because it's pricey but it works so well for my skin. Gifted by Elemis

Gifted by elemis, this is my first time trying out this serum. I have oily/combo skin that is very resilient. I love a good resurfacing serum and this one is pretty unique to me. It is a gel to oil serum that is very hydrating. I have to be careful with not layering any other hydrating serums because I can get oily quickly with this. I have been using it for two weeks straight and have noticed a reduction in texture, but I also notice that it does tingle a little when I apply it, so I would use with caution with sensitive skin types.

extraits.titre: Finally a good quality Vitamin C topical
extraits.texte: I have been applying this every morning for a week and I am wowed by the results. I have some hyperpigmentation from blemishes I shouldn't have picked at and I have never seen them fade this fast. I have normal skin but do live in a dry climate so I lean on the dry side and although the serum increases cell turnover, I do not got any extra dryness. Gifted by elemis
